about.title: Who are we?
about.subtitle: A Chance for the Community
about.description: A CHANCE FOR THE COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION (Asociația O Șansă Pentru Comunitate) is a non-governmental, non-profit organization founded in August 2021 in Cristuru Secuiesc, with the mission to be a catalyst for local community development. We firmly believe that the strength of a community lies in its own resources and that only through collaboration and active participation can we build a better future.
about.history_text: Our association was established on August 27, 2021, by its founding members: Kovács Zsolt, Kerestély Attila, and Kovács Ioan, with the goal to become a driving force for local civil society development. Our headquarters is located at Str. Morii nr. 34, Cristuru Secuiesc, Harghita. Since our establishment, we have been dedicated to creating new opportunities for Cristuru Secuiesc and its surrounding regions.
about.mission_text: We pursue the sustainable development of the local community and support civil society efforts to stimulate community resources. We support progress from a socio-economic and cultural point of view, encouraging citizen participation in local development. Our goals focus on social support, economic development, cultural promotion, education, and environmental protection.
about.vision_text: A vibrant, inclusive, and sustainable community where every citizen has the opportunity to reach their full potential and contribute to collective development.
about.values_intro: Our actions are guided by principles that shape every decision and activity:
about.value_1_text: 100% transparency in resource management and communication with the community
about.value_2_text: No one is left behind - we work for everyone, regardless of background
about.value_3_text: Responsible for our actions and their impact on the community
about.pillar_1_desc: Assistance for vulnerable groups and people in difficult situations
about.pillar_3_desc: Cultural events and protection of local heritage
about.pillar_4_desc: Educational programs and environmental protection initiatives
about.activity_1: Organization of training courses and professional workshops
about.activity_2: Career guidance and job search counseling programs
about.activity_3: Cultural and educational activities for youth and children
about.activity_4: Participation in European projects and development programs
about.activity_5: Partnerships with public administration and other civil organizations
about.activity_6: Charitable assistance for people in need
about.activity_7: Environmental protection and ecological education initiatives
